source.note: All 11 candidate themes cleared the support rule; ADR-0003 caps the taxonomy at ten, so breaks_or_wears_out was merged into poor_build_quality rather than dropped. Nothing was discarded.

rules.complaint_only: Label a theme only when the review complains about it. Praise is never labelled, and a theme mentioned neutrally is not a complaint.
rules.evidence_required: Every labelled theme carries an exact contiguous quote from the review title or text, at most 15 whitespace-delimited words. Never paraphrase, never repair, never invent.
rules.uniqueness: Each theme id may appear at most once per review.
rules.unmentioned: Themes the review does not complain about are omitted, not labelled negative.
rules.other: A complaint that fits none of the ten themes sets other.present=true with a phrase of at most five words. other.phrase is required iff other.present.

themes.name: Does not work
themes.definition: The product fails to produce the effect it is sold for, or one of its functions does not operate at all.
includes: no effect or a much weaker effect than claimed
a powered function that does not run, heat, or hold a charge
the product does the job worse than the thing it replaced
excludes: it worked and then failed or wore out later -> poor_build_quality
it works but is awkward or messy to use -> hard_to_use
it works but the result looks wrong -> not_as_described

themes.name: Poor build quality or durability
themes.definition: The item is cheaply made, defective from manufacture, or breaks and wears out under normal use.
includes: flimsy, thin, or cheap-feeling materials
a manufacturing defect present on an otherwise intact item
breaking, cracking, shedding, or dying after a short period of use
a short lifespan relative to the price or the claim
excludes: damage caused in transit or on arrival -> arrived_damaged
an intact item that never worked at all -> does_not_work
themes.boundary_note: The test against arrived_damaged is cause, not state: manufacture or wear belongs here, shipping belongs there. If the review does not say which, prefer arrived_damaged only when it mentions delivery, packaging, or the moment of unboxing.

themes.name: Overpriced or poor value
themes.definition: The complaint is about price or value for money, not about the product's behaviour.
includes: too expensive for what it is
money wasted
worse than a cheaper alternative at this price
excludes: the product is bad and price is not mentioned -> the relevant product theme

themes.name: Wrong size, weight or fit
themes.definition: The product's physical dimensions, weight, or fit are wrong for the buyer or for the thing it attaches to.
includes: too small or too large
too heavy or too light to handle
does not fit the device, hair type, or body part it is meant for
excludes: the size differs from the listing's stated size -> not_as_described
themes.boundary_note: Against not_as_described: this theme is the buyer's fit problem; not_as_described is a mismatch with what was advertised. A review can hold both.

themes.name: Unpleasant texture or feel
themes.definition: How the product feels in use or on the body is unpleasant.
includes: rough, scratchy, stiff, or hard where softness is expected
sticky, greasy, or leaves a residue
inconsistent or lumpy consistency
uncomfortable to wear or hold
excludes: the feel causes a physical reaction such as burning or a rash -> irritation_or_harm

themes.name: Hard to use
themes.definition: The product works, but using it is difficult, messy, slow, or unexplained.
includes: difficult to apply, assemble, open, or operate
messy in use
takes an unreasonable amount of time
no instructions, or instructions that do not help
a design choice that makes it awkward
excludes: it cannot be used because it does not function -> does_not_work

themes.name: Unpleasant scent
themes.definition: The product smells bad, chemical, or too strong.
includes: a bad or off smell
a chemical or synthetic smell
a scent so strong it is objectionable
a scent that does not match the one advertised, when the complaint is the smell itself
excludes: the smell causes a headache, nausea, or a reaction -> irritation_or_harm as well

themes.name: Not as described or pictured
themes.definition: What arrived does not match the listing, the photograph, or the stated purpose.
includes: wrong or mismatched colour
looks different from the picture
the description is inaccurate, confusing, or oversells
sold for a use it is not suited to
excludes: it matches the listing but is badly made -> poor_build_quality

themes.name: Irritation or harm
themes.definition: The product hurt the user or damaged their skin, eyes, or hair, or behaved unsafely.
includes: burning, stinging, itching, redness, or a rash
eye irritation
hair breakage, pulling, or loss caused by the product
overheating or another safety hazard
excludes: merely unpleasant to touch with no reaction -> unpleasant_texture

themes.name: Arrived damaged
themes.definition: The item or its packaging was damaged, broken, or leaking on arrival.
includes: broken, cracked, scratched, or crushed in transit
leaked or spilled in the box
damaged or opened packaging
excludes: broke later during normal use -> poor_build_quality
themes.boundary_note: See the boundary note on poor_build_quality. The distinguishing signal is a mention of delivery, packaging, or unboxing.
